body:
At the moment we have:
* 1.9.1 [DELETED, DUPLICATE OF 9.1.1, 9.2.2, 9.3.1]
* 1.9.2 [DELETED, DUPLICATE OF 9.2.3, 9.3.2]

The "DUPLICATE OF" points to v4.0.3 requirement and we did not have requirements 9.3.1 and 9.3.2.

One option is to replace "DUPLCIATE OF" to "COVERED BY" and use v5.0 references.

comments.body:
The current 'DUPLICATE OF' points to the v4.0.3 requirement, but it means that it does not have a matching reference on the v5.0 side. It means when we watch v5.0 to v4.0.3 mapping, we can not see what v4.0.3 requirements it covers.

The difference compared to 'MERGED TO' was that 'MERGED TO' caused changes to another requirement while 'DUPLICATE OF' did not. The point is the same - this v5 requirement now covers the previous v4 requirement. We have currently 27 requirements with that tag.

So I propose I update all 'DUPLICATE OF' to 'MERGED TO'. Otherwise, we need to invent a new pair of tags.

ping @tghosth

So I decided to use new mapping pair `COVERED BY` for v4.0.3 requirement + `COVERS` for v5.0 requirement.

Changes are made, PR is ready for review.
